## Key points {.unnumbered}

- Read the message before the call: the message says what went wrong, the call says where.
- Most beginner errors are a typo, a missing bracket, or a missing quote.
- An error stops the code; a warning lets it finish and reports something suspicious.
- Shrink the problem: tiny data, one line, half the code at a time.
- When you ask for help, paste a reprex as text, message included.
